question.text: A compound $\mathrm{M}_{\mathrm{p}} \mathrm{X}_{\mathrm{q}}$ has cubic close packing (ccp) arrangement of $\mathrm{X}$. Its unit cell structure is shown below. The empirical formula of the compound is

solution.text:
No. of $M$ atoms $=\frac{1}{4} \times 4+1=1+1=2$

No. of $X$ atoms $=\frac{1}{2} \times 6+\frac{1}{8} \times 8=3+1=4$

So, formula $=M_{2} X_{4}=M X_{2}$
